notable_absence.predicate: storage-engine / cloud-provider / cluster-option as modifiable attributes
notable_absence.finding: This page's own enumerated scope (echoed from databases.md: 'you can only change: cluster name/description, Support Plan, recovery authorization, Services and Service Groups, compute configuration, storage configuration, deletion protection') never lists cloud service provider, region, or basic cluster option (Single Node/Multi-Node/Custom) among the modifiable attributes, and the page's own section list (View Node Configs, Add/Remove Service, Add/Remove Nodes, Change Compute, Change Disk Type, Increase Storage, Change IOPS, Rename, Deletion Protection) contains no 'change cloud provider' or 'change cluster option' procedure. No page in this batch states outright that these are immutable after creation - it's an absence, not an explicit constraint - but the omission across both the reference page (databases.md) and the modify procedure (this page) is consistent and suggests cloud provider and cluster option are fixed at creation time. Storage engine doesn't appear on this page at all, consistent with the databases.json finding that it may not be a cluster-level setting.

cross_component_finding: Deletion protection is defined here but its blocking effect and its App Services cascade were quoted independently by delete-database.json and this file for the same underlying setting - reconciler should treat clusters:deletion-protection as one concept with evidence from both pages, not two.
